title: Q3 Runway: Unified Hosted API + Model Catalog Roadmap and Release Runbook
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: create a coordinated Q3 plan that aligns Hosted API release windows, model catalog curation, and canary gating so customers see predictable latency/cost behavior during model rotations and new model launches.

Scope: Hosted API endpoints (text generation, chat, embeddings) + curated model flavors in the public model catalog. Deliverables include a release runbook, canary cadence for model swaps, curated default model lineup for GA customers, migration/migration rollback guidelines, and a dashboard slice in Console showing per-model unit economics and quality regressions.

Why now: Several customers reported variability in token latency and cost after recent model swaps. The platform team wants a formalized quarterly runway for model lineup changes to reduce incidents and customer support load. This initiative is the product-facing coordination layer to ensure PMs, Eng, Design, and Research share criteria and timelines for onboarding/deprecating models.

Trade-offs considered:
- Broad catalog vs operational burden: we will limit GA catalog to a high-confidence set (6-8 flavors) while enabling a discovery channel for preview models.
- Strict gating increases time-to-ship vs risk of regressions; we will adopt lightweight automated evals + a short canary window for low-risk launches and extended canaries for high-traffic endpoints.
- Reserving Dedicated capacity for large customers reduces risk but increases cost; recommend a cost-allocation playbook for customers requesting pinned variants.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook authored: step-by-step canary plan, rollback criteria, and communication template
Model catalog GA lineup finalized (6-8 flavors) with arch/quantization notes and default routing rules
Automated eval suite runs for each candidate model against 3 priority prompt sets with pass/fail thresholds
Canary executed for at least one model swap on staging and production with observed metrics tracked (latency, p95, cost/token, hallucination rate)
Console dashboard slice created showing per-model cost delta and recent quality regressions
Migration guide and deprecation notice templates published to Confluence and sent to beta customers
